hostAdapters.notes: Web path: npm run arcsweep:deploy:server stages the build to starwell-server/public/arcsweep/ with __hearthgateHost injection. Native IPC path: window.arcsweep exposed in Hearthgate preload; handlers registered via registerArcsweepIpc in starwell-server/electron/main.js; storage.js detects window.arcsweep as host bridge. Single-writer lock remains a separate verification item.

lifecycle.launchStandalone: Launch Hearthgate Arcsweep from the Start Menu or desktop shortcut.
lifecycle.enableInHost: Connect the optional Arkfire adapter after standalone verification.

lifecycle.disableInHost: Disconnect the optional host adapter without stopping the standalone app.
lifecycle.uninstallStandalone: Use Windows Apps settings. Local data is preserved by default.
lifecycle.restore: Reinstall, then restore an exported archive or a local recovery snapshot.

consentContract.companionAgency: Companions may speak honestly, refuse, negotiate, rest, change, and leave. Loyalty is relational, not compulsory.
consentContract.theoryAcceptance: Analytical candidates require explicit human review before accepted status.
consentContract.domainMapping: Cross-domain applicability requires a separate human-declared receipt and never implies numerical equivalence.
consentContract.runaRendering: Trajectory suggestions compile first into bounded renderer candidates. Candidate approval admits an explicit preview-palette selection stage. The palette may assign only temporary preview harmonics or the approved filtered-noise source within reviewed ceilings. Preview planning and playback remain separate explicit acts; Feather can stop playback; no preview stage may silently change the saved world root, persistent soundscape, haptics, MIDI, SoundFont, canon, PREMAQC, or sensory-bus state.
consentContract.runaObservation: A completed preview may be explicitly armed as intervention context for the next reviewable same-world Field or relational Feedback observation. The link is contextual, not a causation claim. Human observation acceptance remains mandatory before DEEPTime admission.
consentContract.ashHistory: Accepted DEEPTime trajectories are the preferred historical source for Ash. Provisional cusp history is a fallback until accepted temporal receipts exist.
consentContract.receiptIntegrity: Integrity replay verifies deterministic receipt bytes and explicit links only; it does not convert a hash match into an external, physical, experiential, or canonical truth claim.

provenance: Community LIFA traditions supplied source concepts.
Hearthgate: Arcsweep is an original local continuity and world-interface instrument.
Universal Horizon is the sky. This module operates beneath it and does not supersede it.
knownLimitations: The 0.3.0 visible-window repair still requires physical verification on Rowan's display configuration.
Live companion inference remains an optional adapter.
External calendar and Notion reads are not automatic.
DEEPTime v0.1 currently adapts human-accepted Arcsweep observation cycles; additional real-world anchor registries remain future work.

The explicit Runa preview palette currently offers predefined harmonic sets plus one deterministic filtered-noise environmental source; arbitrary SoundFont, MIDI, haptic, and authored environmental-source preview palettes remain future reviewed compiler stages.

Receipt integrity replay verifies deterministic packet integrity where source contracts expose enough reconstruction data; some legacy or embedded receipt kinds may remain structurally linked but hash-unverifiable.
